_comment: First-session tutorial. Each step shows a message anchored to a UI element or world target, and completes when the named game event fires (count times).

steps.text: Welcome to the claim, Foreman! The old company left this mine to rot. Let's bring it back to life.
Tap the glowing ore vein in the Topsoil Drift to swing your pick. Keep tapping!
Ore piles up at the shaft station. Tap LIFT to wind it up to the surface.
The conveyor carries it to the warehouse. Tap SELL to send the truck to market.
Money! Open the Topsoil Drift panel and hire a miner - they work while you rest.
Upgrade Mining Operations to make every miner faster.
Quests give big rewards. Check them often!
Automate the lift and the trucks, dig deeper, and build a mining empire. Good luck!
